title: Two Goats for the Farm
offer: I would love goat's milk and cheese again. Buy two goats at the horse farm in Torsgården and row them home. Each goat takes the room of a crate!

steps.say: Two goats! Listen to them bleat. They will give us milk and cheese, and eat the hay of the meadow.

fact: Goats were kept for milk and cheese; their skin was made into leather.
